name: cinecraft-android-hybrid
description: Separate Capacitor Android Hybrid project packaging the original CineCraft AI Studio web build without altering original source files.

scripts.android:build: npm run package:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p ../APK_DOWNLOAD ../.build-outputs && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../APK_DOWNLOAD/app-debug.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../.build-outputs/app-debug.apk
